text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: eval-gate 'safety_regression_v2' breached for model rdx-13b@v3. Severity: P1. Trigger: output_safety_score drop > 12% over 15m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PDTK-4219

pagerduty: Page details:
- Triggered by: eval-evaluator-prod (rk-evals)
- Symptoms: sharp increase in blocked/safe outputs and hallucination markers on prompts from prod traffic set 'alpha-sim'
- Affected routes: /chat/generate (hosted-api-us)
- Suggested runbook: eval-gate -> inspect eval run, roll to safe model variant, notify CS

Olivia Chen: Acked oncall. I'm taking primary. Starting immediate triage.

Samir Patel: On call with you Olivia. Pulling recent eval runs + diffs. Running quick check on model metrics.

Maria Lopez: Notifying CS triage that we may see customer-impact (higher safety closures). I have incoming ticket from Prod-Alpha customer saying responses flagged as unsafe.

Olivia Chen: Steps I'm doing: 1) confirm eval run that tripped gate, 2) check if rollout/auto-update happened in last 24h, 3) if surge is model-internal, switch routing to fallback rdx-7b-stable.

Devon Reed: I'll check infra — any spike in tokens or latency that could cause decoding differences? Also checking if quantization job was applied to v3.

Samir Patel: Ran eval diff: yesterday vs baseline shows safety_score mean down from 0.92 -> 0.78 on the alpha promptset. Top failing categories: sexual_content, misinformation. No config changes in serving config according to config-store.

Olivia Chen: Querying model meta: 
```
rdwctl model inspect rdx-13b@v3 --fields=deploy_time,config_hash,quantization
```
Outputs: deploy_time: 2026-03-14T02:10:11Z, config_hash: 37a9b4, quantization: none

Olivia Chen: So no recent quantization. Suspicious: recent tokenizer tweak merged last week to shared tokenization pipeline. Samir, can you grep eval logs for tokenization anomalies?

Samir Patel: Grepping... found 0.6% tokenization divergence on alpha prompts compared to baseline tokenization (changed subword splits). That could change prefixing and safety triggers.

Anita (CS): Customer-impact note: Prod-Alpha experienced 24 user-visible policy closures in the last 30m (normally <2). CS prepping message to affected customer cohort (pre-approved template).

Olivia Chen: Immediate mitigation: switch routing for /chat/generate to fallback-model-policy: rdx-7b-stable (no rollout). Applying now.

oncall-rotation-bot: Routing change applied: route /chat/generate -> rdx-7b-stable (reason: safety_regression_v2). Rollout disabled for rdx-13b@v3.

Samir Patel: Verifying traffic: traffic for /chat/generate now at 100% rdx-7b-stable. Monitoring safety metrics.

Devon Reed: Infra note: no resource exhaustion. No change in kernel versions. Latency steady. Not an infra flake.

Samir Patel: Quick metrics after fallback: safety closures dropped to baseline within 6 minutes. False-positive closure rate down. Looks like model-level change (tokenization/weights) caused the regression.

Olivia Chen: Good. Next: pause rollout on CI/CD for model v3, open immediate postmortem ticket, and schedule deep eval of tokenization differences + upstream tokenizer PRs.

Maria Lopez: CS has sent an interim update to Prod-Alpha and opened a dedicated support thread. They've acknowledged the fallback and appreciate quick mitigation.

Olivia Chen: Escalation check: PagerDuty hasn't auto-escalated, but I'm manually adding ML-research and tokenization owners. @Samir @Devon can you triage root cause with Research and Tokenization?

Samir Patel: On it. I'll start bisecting tokenizer commits from last 14 days against the alpha promptset.

Devon Reed: I'll reproduce locally: run inference with pre/post tokenizers and diff token streams + decode. Also running inference with pinned seed to see determinism.

Olivia Chen: Customer impact summary for postmortem (for now):
- Affected customers: Prod-Alpha (high confidence), ~24 customer-visible closures in 30m window.
- Scope: single route (/chat/generate) in hosted-us region.
- Duration (mitigated): ~12 minutes from page to fallback completion.
- Severity: P1 (safety regression with customer impact).

Anita (CS): CS follow-up actions: notify other affected customers if detected, offer usage credits if escalation requested.

Samir Patel: Found probable culprit: tokenizer PR 2026-03-13 changed subword merge rules -> caused different embeddings around content boundaries. Reverting test shows baseline safety_score returns. Will open revert PR + test harness to catch this in future.

Olivia Chen: Creating incident ticket in trackers: https://tickets.example/INC-4721. Adding tags: safety_regression, eval-gate, rollback, oncall-response. Assigning to Samir for root cause and Devon for infra reproduction.

Devon Reed: Reproduction steps saved in incident ticket with logs and commands. Example command used to compare token streams:
```
python -m rdx.tools.token-diff --model rdx-13b@v3 --prompts=alpha-sample-1.txt --baseline-tokenizer=commit-abc123 --new-tokenizer=commit-def456
```

Samir Patel: Revert PR created: rdx/tokenizer@revert-2026-03-13. CI run for eval gate queued. Will block any automated rollouts until green.

Olivia Chen: Closing the live incident thread: fallback is stable, CS engaged, revert PR open, oncall remains to monitor for 60m then handback to standard rotation. Please add any follow-up actions to the incident ticket.

Anita (CS): Thanks team. Sending update to Prod-Alpha now.

oncall-rotation-bot: Monitor window started for 60m. If safety_score deviates >5% from baseline, incident-bot will re-page.

Olivia Chen: Handing off to next oncall at 2139999005. Next oncall: Devon Reed will watch the monitor window.

Devon Reed: Acknowledged handoff. I'll escalate if anything re-trips.

Samir Patel: Adding post-incident actions: 1) Tokenizer unit-tests for alpha promptset, 2) Add eval-gate synthetic fuzz harness, 3) Improve pre-deploy canary for tokenization changes.

Olivia Chen: Thanks everyone. Marking this thread resolved for live ops. We'll move the rest of the discussion to the incident ticket for the postmortem.
